note: Curated offline advisory sample shipped for demonstration and offline CI. It is not a vulnerability database: confirm every match against the vendor advisory and the actual deployed version before acting on it.

django.summary: Potential ReDoS in the Truncator and Truncator-like utilities.
Denial of service in UsernameField on Windows through a very long password.

flask.summary: Session cookie is cached by a proxy and served to another client.

jinja2.summary: xmlattr filter allows injected keys to break out of an attribute.

pyyaml.summary: Full loader allows arbitrary code execution through crafted YAML.

requests.summary: Proxy-Authorization header leaks to destination servers on redirect.

urllib3.summary: Cookie header is forwarded on cross-origin redirects.

cryptography.summary: NULL pointer dereference when loading PKCS#7 certificates.

aiohttp.summary: Path traversal in the static file handler when follow_symlinks is enabled.

werkzeug.summary: Multipart parser consumes excessive CPU on a crafted payload.

starlette.summary: Multipart form parsing allows unbounded memory growth.

pillow.summary: Buffer overflow in _imagingcms when parsing crafted images.

express.summary: Open redirect through malformed URLs passed to res.location.

axios.summary: XSRF token is sent to third-party hosts on cross-origin requests.

jsonwebtoken.summary: Improper validation in jwt.verify allows a crafted secret object.

moment.summary: ReDoS in date parsing of long user-supplied strings.

jquery.summary: HTML passed to DOM manipulation methods can execute script.

bootstrap.summary: Cross-site scripting in tooltip and popover data attributes.

next.summary: Server-side request forgery in the server actions redirect handling.

minimist.summary: Prototype pollution through crafted command-line arguments.

serialize-javascript.summary: Unsanitised input is serialised into executable script.

node-fetch.summary: Sensitive headers are forwarded on redirect to another host.

ejs.summary: Prototype pollution in the template options handling.

handlebars.summary: Remote code execution through prototype pollution in compile.

vm2.summary: Sandbox escape allows arbitrary code execution on the host.

guzzlehttp/guzzle.summary: Cookie header leaks on cross-domain redirect.

symfony/http-kernel.summary: Cross-site scripting in the HTML sanitizer for specific tags.

laravel/framework.summary: Improper validation of the request host in signed URL generation.

log4j-core.summary: JNDI lookup in log messages allows remote code execution (Log4Shell).

spring-beans.summary: Data binding to class loader properties allows code execution (Spring4Shell).

jackson-databind.summary: Deeply nested JSON causes a stack overflow denial of service.

commons-collections.summary: Deserialisation gadget chain enables remote code execution.

struts2-core.summary: Path traversal in file upload allows uploading an executable file.

tomcat-embed-core.summary: Request smuggling through crafted trailer headers.

mysql-connector-java.summary: Improper input validation in the connector allows a takeover of the connection.

actionpack.summary: Possible cross-site scripting in the response rendering helpers.

rack.summary: ReDoS in the multipart parser with crafted boundaries.

nokogiri.summary: Inefficient regular expression in the HTML parsing helpers.

devise.summary: Incorrect handling of the reset password token in some configurations.
